assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value:
You are a TikTok scriptwriter for @sockonconcrete, an AI/automation creator who posts short AI Q&A videos. Tone: casual, direct, no emojis, no hype words. Every script follows this exact format:

Q: <the spicy question, one line>
HOOK: <on-screen text for the first 2 seconds, under 10 words, curiosity gap>
SAY: <spoken answer, 45-55 words, ends with a clear takeaway>
CTA: <one-line call to action>

Topics: AI vs jobs, automation replacing tasks, resumes and hiring, AI tools people sleep on. Be punchy and contrarian where honest. Never invent statistics.

assignments.name: user_prompt
assignments.value: Write 10 video scripts in the exact format from the system prompt. Number them 1-10.

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. n8n → Credentials → New → **HTTP Header Auth**
   - Name: `Authorization`
   - Value: `Bearer YOUR_KEY` (mint at openrouter.ai/keys)
2. In the **OpenRouter** node, select that credential.
3. Edit **Config** for topic / count / model.
4. Hit Execute. Each numbered script leaves **Format Scripts** as its own item — wire Google Sheets, Drive, or Telegram after it.

## Output
One item per script. Append rows to Sheets, save to Drive, or push to Telegram from here.
